Overview

Leiden is a city in South Holland with a population of 130,108. A picturesque university town famous for its canals, historic ties to the Pilgrims, and a relaxed, intellectual atmosphere close to The Hague and Amsterdam. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
